description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.7 quest.deserters, §5.9): the sergeant of the deserters hiding at the burned mill south of the war camp - he speaks for his three men. Spared, they give the giant their word for a parley with Aldmere (a token), mark the war camp's engines and pay 1 iron from their chest; handed over, the war camp pays a bounty of 2 iron. Protected, never flees (a talker).
